# Daqi (static storefront)

> Daqi.SHOP is a fast static storefront for Daqi's global catalogue of downloadable digital products: AI prompt packs, collectible card packs, planners, printables, wallpapers, templates, and faith & culture products in many languages. All items are digital with instant delivery.

## Key pages
- Static storefront: https://daqi-shop.pages.dev/
- Full store (checkout): https://daqi.shop/
- Full store sitemap: https://daqi.shop/sitemap_index.xml
- Full store llms.txt: https://daqi.shop/llms.txt
